findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The dish machine in the bar area has not been repaired yet. The company repairing the machine arrived during the follow-up inspection. Ensure that staff are not using this dish machine to wash, rinse, and sanitize dishes. If the dish machine is used, the dishes need to be sanitized in the triple sink after being ran through the dish machine. A follow up is scheduled for 12/19/2025 to ensure that the dish machine has been repaired and is properly sanitizing at a label-recommended concentration.
findings.citation_text: 4-702.11 Before Use After Cleaning. UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be SANITIZED before use after cleaning.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: FIRST REPEAT- An employee was observed to not use a barrier to turn off the faucet after washing their hands. CORRECTED- The employee was educated on the proper handwashing procedure and was later observed to use the proper handwashing procedure. Ensure that all staff are educated on proper handwashing and are using a barrier when turning off the faucet to avoid re-contamination.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: There is observed to be ice in a basin that is uncovered. Ice should be covered when not in use to prevent contamination. Ensure that a cover is provided when ice is not actively being used. A follow up is scheduled for 12/19/2025 to ensure that there is a cover over the ice to protect the ice from contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(4) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (4) Except as specified under Subparagraph 3-501.15(B)(2) and in (B) of this section, storing the food in packages, covered containers, or wrappings.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The dish machine in the bar area is observed to be sanitizing at 0ppm of Chlorine. This was discussed with the PIC. Ensure that staff are not using this dish machine to wash, rinse, and sanitize dishes. If the dish machine is used, the dishes need to be sanitized in the triple sink after being ran through the dish machine. A follow up is scheduled for 12/15/2025 to ensure that the dish machine has been repaired and is properly sanitizing at a label-recommended concentration.
findings.citation_text: 4-702.11 Before Use After Cleaning. UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be SANITIZED before use after cleaning.

findings.title: Single use/single service articles are properly stored and used.
findings.comment: There are single-use straws that are observed to be in a container on the bar counter that are unwrapped. Single-service articles should be wrapped to protect them from contamination. The straw being unwrapped exposes it to contamination, as the employee either needs to grab the straw to place it in the drink or the consumer will need to grab the straw and could potentially contaminate the other straws in the container. Ensure that straws that are wrapped are obtained to protect them from contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-904.11(A) Kitchenware and Tableware. (A) SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of FOOD- and lip-contact surfaces is prevented.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: The facility is observed to be using Purell sanitizer spray to sanitize surfaces, but does not have a test strip for this sanitizer. A test strip is necessary to ensure that the sanitizer is at the correct concentration. Ensure that a test strip is obtained for Purell sanitizer spray or cease use of it and use the Quaternary ammonium sanitizer to wipe down food-contact surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
The following nonfood contact surfaces are observed to be in need of cleaning: 

1. FIRST REPEAT- There is an accumulation of popcorn and food debris on the floor under the equipment across from the popcorn machine. 
2. The nonfood contact surfaces of the slushy machines were observed to have an accumulation of dust on them. 

This was shown to the PIC. Ensure that nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned and maintained cleaned.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed.
findings.comment: There is a drip leak observed to be coming from under the triple sink in the kitchen. A follow up is scheduled for 12/15/2025 to ensure that the leak has been repaired. Ensure that plumbing is maintained in good repair to allow for proper disposal of sewage.
findings.citation_text: 5-402.13 Conveying Sewage. SEWAGE shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an APPROVED sanitary SEWAGE system or other system, including use of SEWAGE transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.12: An employee was observed to wash their hands and then turn off the faucet without a barrier. When washing your hands, you always need to use a barrier, such as a paper towel, to turn off the faucet to avoid contamination to your hands. Educate all employees on proper handwashing procedure. CORRECTED: Staff was educated on proper handwashing. 

(A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: In the back kitchen area, there was a measuring cup in the handwashing sink. Ensure that handwashing sinks are only used for the purpose of handwashing. Educate staff on this and always ensure that handwashing sinks are accessible at all times for employee use. CORRECTED: The measuring cup was removed and staff was educated on ensuring that handwashing sinks are always accessible and only used for handwashing. 

 (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing.

findings.title: Approved thawing methods used
findings.comment:
3-501.13: An employee was observed to thaw a package of frozen hot dogs submerged in a container of still water. Ensure that TCS food is thawed in refrigeration, as part of the cooking process, or under running water. Educate all staff on proper thawing procedures. CORRECTED- Staff was educated on thawing and the hot dogs were switched to a proper thawing method. 

TCS FOOD shall be thawed: (A) at 41F or below in refrigeration (B) completely submerged under running water, not getting above 41F (water temp of 70F or below). If food will be cooked, not getting above 41F for more than 4 hours. (C) part of the cooking process

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
4-903.11: FIRST REPEAT: There are single-use articles that are stored with the food contact surface side exposed to contamination. Ensure that all single use articles are stored inverted to protect it against contamination. CORRECTED: The single use articles were inverted during the inspection. 

(C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: The following nonfood contact surfaces were observed to be in need of a cleaning: 

1. The counter behind the soda and freeze fountains. 
2. The dish shelves. 

Ensure that all nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned as often as necessary to prevent accumulation of soil residues. 

 NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The following areas were observed to be in need of a cleaning: 

1. Inside the cabinet under the front counter butter station. 
2. Under and around the popcorn station. 
3. The floor in the back kitchen area was observed to have a build up of soil on it. 
4. The floors in the upstairs storage room. 
5. Underneath the triple sink. 

Ensure that all of these areas are cleaned and then maintained cleaned. Physical facilities should be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. 

(A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment: 4-903.11: Observed single-use food containers to not be stored in an inverted fashion next to prep cooler. Store single-use articles in an inverted fashion to avoid contamination (A) clean EQUIPMENT and clean ARTICLES shall be stored in clean, dry location where they are not exposed to contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 4-602.13: Observed food residue present on shelving unit located between nacho machine and soda machine.  NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.citation_text: 750.540 (C) Observed no certified Food Manager to be on duty at time of inspection, when food was being prepared and served.  A Certified Food Manager must be on duty at all times when food is being prepared and served.  The food establishment is not under the operational supervision of a Certified Food Service Sanitation Manager that is present at appropriate times. Provide an adequate number of staff with approved training. Reference 750.540.
